info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables authorized users to cancel scheduled airline flights efficiently. It is primarily designed for airline operational teams who need to manage flight schedules and respond to customer requests for cancellations. By utilizing this endpoint, users can remove flights from the active roster, ensuring that updates are reflected in real-time for booking systems and customer notifications. Typical consumers include airline staff and integrated travel management systems. Implementing this functionality helps streamline operations and improve customer communication during disruptions.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel their booked flights by providing the necessary identifiers. Upon successful cancellation, the flight will be marked as canceled in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for cancelling a flight. It must contain the necessary information for identifying the flight that needs to be canceled.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a flight operation using the DELETE method.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the result of the operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_201.description: The response schema for a successful cancellation operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the audit entry was created, in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
